title: Spicy Duck Rillettes Crostini
description: A French-inspired appetizer featuring spicy duck rillettes served on toasted gluten-free crostini.
instructions: 2. Season the duck breast with warm spices, salt, and black pepper.
3. Sear the duck breast in a hot skillet until browned, then finish cooking in the oven until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
4. Let the duck breast rest before shredding into rillettes.
5. Toast the gluten-free bread until crispy.
6. Spread a layer of unsalted butter on each toasted bread slice.
7. Top each bread slice with a spoonful of duck rillettes.
